reviews.text: I had an appointment with Michelle, she was kind, professional and did an amazing job on my hair!! She listened to what I wanted and executed it to a T!!! Thanks to her I am in my copper era!! It’s giving Jessica Rabbit!
Fiona is amazing!!! She always makes me feel so beautiful every time I walk in and out of this salon! She takes her time and she loves what she does!!
Love it here. I schedule with Fiona she's amazing! She takes her time with you; she's really sweet/nice. I will never go to anyone else. I love my hair!
